description: Source file implementing configuration translation functions for CU-CP components, including QoS, security, report configurations, and N2 client setup.

methods.name: generate_cu_cp_qos_config
methods.description: Generates QoS configuration map based on cu_cp_unit_config.

methods.name: generate_preferred_integrity_algorithms_list
methods.description: Creates list of preferred integrity algorithms from security config.

methods.name: generate_preferred_ciphering_algorithms_list
methods.description: Creates list of preferred ciphering algorithms from security config.

methods.name: generate_rrc_ssb_mtc
methods.description: Generates RRC SSB measurement timing configuration.

methods.name: generate_cu_cp_periodical_report_config
methods.description: Builds periodical report configuration for CU-CP.

methods.name: build_meas_trigger_threshold
methods.description: Builds measurement trigger for absolute thresholds (A1-A5).

methods.name: build_meas_trigger_offset
methods.description: Builds measurement trigger for relative offsets (A3, A6).

methods.name: generate_cu_cp_trigger_report_config
methods.description: Builds event-based report configuration for CU-CP.

methods.name: generate_cu_cp_config
methods.description: Generates full CU-CP configuration from cu_cp_unit_config.

methods.name: generate_n2_client_config
methods.description: Creates N2 connection client configuration based on parameters.

methods.name: fill_cu_cp_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Populates worker manager config with CU-CP executor and PCAP settings.
